text:
Elena (sales): Quick handoff for BeaconPay — closed deal last week. They want private deployment (VPC) + SSO. Go-live target: 2026-04-15. Renewal conversation due in 9 months, but flagged as medium risk because of latency concerns from their infra team.

Mohit (CS): Thanks Elena. I'll take lead for onboarding. Main things we need from sales/eng: SSO SAML certs, VPC CIDR, and a list of high-throughput routes. Any known perf hotspots? :eyes:

Elena (sales): Their infra noted latency spikes when prompt length > 1k tokens and heavy concurrent embedding requests. Also asked about data residency for logs. Sales sent initial SOW + compliance packet — link: https://redwood.internal/docs/beaconpay-sow (internal)

Jordan (CSM): Looping in Tara for eng blockers. I'll own the customer-facing onboarding plan and weekly checkins. Proposed first enablement call Wed 2026-03-18.

Tara (eng-oncall): Hi — I can support the VPC and perf investigations. Need their network team to whitelist 172.31.0.0/16 (example) and open ports 443/8443 to our private control plane. Also request: sample slow request logs and a trace for a large prompt. Can you attach a HAR or trace?

Elena (sales): Will get network contact and certs by EOD tomorrow. Customer asked about pinning model to avoid quality regressions; prefer a stable variant (llama-3-13b-q4) for now.

Mohit (CS): Noted. Action owners and next steps: 
- Jordan: schedule Wed enablement, send agenda + invite (due: 2026-03-12)
- Tara: prep VPC onboarding checklist + temporary perf mitigations (due: 2026-03-14)
- Elena: drop SAML cert + network contact in thread (due: 2026-03-11)
- DevOps (cc @Tara): triage perf ticket if logs show KV cache thrash (we may suggest increasing cache or reducing batch window)

Tara (eng-oncall): For quick mitigation, advise customer to try a smaller batch size and enable prefix KV caching. Example curl to set request-level batch_hint: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"llama-3-13b-q4","input":"<payload>","meta":{"batch_hint":1}}'
```
This lets us lower latency while we tune the runtime.

Jordan (CSM): I'll include that workaround in the enablement notes. Also capturing feedback ask: customer wants alerting for token-cost spikes and a weekly summary of latency percentiles. Can we auto-provision a dashboard?

Tara (eng-oncall): Yes, we can spin up a per-customer dashboard in Console (requires a tag: customer:beaconpay). I'll request 30-day retention for logs during onboarding.

Mohit (CS): Created internal support ticket INC-20260310-8422 for perf/SLA followup. Tara, assigning to you for triage. Elena, please upload SAML certs to the secure share and paste the link here when ready.

Elena (sales): Uploaded certs here: https://files.redwood.internal/secure/beaconpay/saml-cert.pem :thumbsup:

DevBot: Deployment job scheduled — private-controlplane-provision for beaconpay in staging on 2026-03-16 03:00 UTC.

Jordan (CSM): Plan for next 48 hours: 1) Confirm network allowlist, 2) Tara to validate staging deploy, 3) Wed enablement invite. I'll run a readiness checklist during the invite. If anything blocks, tag #eng-oncall.

Mohit (CS): Renewal note: customer indicated interest in a 12-month reserved capacity if latency < 100ms p95 for their main route. We should track this as a win condition. I'll record in Gainsight and set an alert if we miss SLA two weeks in a row.

Tara (eng-oncall): Acknowledged. Will start with load test in staging after deploy and post results here (simple CSV of p50/p95/p99).

Jordan (CSM): Thanks team. I'll DM weekly sync notes and post a public status in this thread every Friday. :wave:
